name: NINE HEAVENS MAHJONG: M88 Edition
description: A formally codified GLMZ variant of the ancient tile game, incorporating 16 additional 'District Tiles' representing M88's ward system alongside the traditional suit and honor tiles; played with physical carved tiles in traditional settings and with optional AR overlay for tracking scores and district-specific rule variants. The M88 edition formalized rules that had been evolving informally across the city's pan-Asian heritage communities since the 2160s, and the codification itself became a cultural milestone.
story_hooks: A specific arrangement of District Tiles, appearing spontaneously in games across the city, is recognized by a Shelf elder as a warning signal used by pre-M88 resistance networks.
A Nine Heavens tournament bracket has been quietly manipulated so that specific players from different tiers will meet — someone wants them in the same room at the same time.
An heirloom Mahjong set smuggled out of a demolished Tier 2 district contains tiles whose engravings, read in sequence, form a complete map of a pre-flood underground network.
